title: SKE Crystal Plus Cucumber Lime Prefilled Pods 20mg
description: Please Note: These pods are not compatible with the SKE BAR device. Cucumber Lime flavour SKE Crystal Plus prefilled pods offer a unique blend of crisp cucumber and zesty lime for a refreshingly cool and tangy vape. The mellow, smooth notes of cucumber are perfectly complemented by the vibrant citrus kick of lime, creating a clean and invigorating flavour profile ideal for all-day vaping. Designed for use with the SKE Crystal Plus Pod Kit, these prefilled pods combine convenience with exceptional flavour. Sharing the signature crystalline design of the popular SKE Crystal Bars, these pods offer a more sustainable and mess-free vaping experience. Each pod contains 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, delivering a smoother throat hit and faster nicotine absorption compared to standard e-liquids. With a 1.1ohm mesh coil, the pods produce satisfying flavour and vapour, making them perfect for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping styles. The prefilled, disposable design ensures you can switch flavours effortlessly—simply replace the pod when it’s empty for a hassle-free vaping experience. Please Note: SKE Crystal Plus pods include a protective seal that must be removed before use. Detach the bung from the top of the mouthpiece and allow the pod to sit for 5-10 minutes to ensure the coil is fully saturated with e-liquid, preventing dry hits or burnt coils
